title: Amicus composed live council-run doc (amicus_status/buildCouncilStatusPayload, view:'live')

legs.description: One row per active-stage leg id (DE-ROT Task 0.5 / F01), present unconditionally — a just-started leg with no usage flushed yet still gets a row.

modelInput.description: Council alias (run.json bench/chair/critic/lenses are keyed on this, not `model`); null when the leg's metadata.json has not been patched with it yet (F36).

role.description: 'seat' | 'critic' | 'lens:<slug>' | 'chair', derived via roleFor keyed on modelInput (chair via the owning stage's name instead, F34); null when modelInput is unknown.

usageError.description: Council review C3: set when enrichLegUsage (pricing resolution) throws for this leg's progress usage, so the failure is distinguishable from a leg that simply has not billed yet (no `usage` key, no `usageError` key either). Additive; absent on every leg that priced cleanly or has no usage yet.
